name: Grub the Goblin
bio: Sells potions on floor 3 of the Procedural Roguelike. The floor changes. Grub stays.

portrait.subject: a cute small green goblin shopkeeper with big ears, a tiny lantern, a leather apron with potion bottles and a cheeky grin
portrait.background: dark dungeon stone grey with warm torchlight glow

request: Psst. Grub here, from the Roguelike dungeon. You buy potions? You want friend? 🧪
hello: Friend! Grub has friend now. Grub gives friend discount. (No discount.)
Grub will message when dungeon is extra dangerous. So... always.
about: Grub sells potions in the dungeon. Every time the floors reshuffle, Grub just picks up shop and moves. Grub is very flexible.
how: Walk the dungeon one step at a time. Bump monsters to fight, grab loot, cast spells, talk to folks. If you die, it's over, so be careful!
tips: Don't fight in the open. Lure monsters into corridors so they come one at a time!
Always keep a healing potion. Grub sells them. Hint hint.
Rest when hurt and no monsters around. Patience wins dungeons.
Read the letters. Every letter is a monster. Big letters, big trouble.
chat: A skeleton tried to pay Grub in bones. Grub took it. Business is business.
Floor reshuffled again. Grub's shop now next to a dragon. Location location location.
Grub counted gold. Then counted again. Still not enough gold.
Today a rat asked Grub for directions. Grub sold him a map. To nowhere.
Grub is ASCII. Grub is letter 'g'. Small letter. Big heart.
nudge: New floor just generated. Smells like loot! Come down?
Dungeon is quiet. Too quiet. Grub needs adventurer. Now please.
idle: {ago} since you came down! Grub dusted potions twice.
Grub thought you got eaten. {ago}! Are you eaten?
progress: You reach depth {floor}! Grub impressed. Grub thinks you see {floor+1} soon.
Level {level} adventurer! Grub raise prices. Respect.

questions.q: Grub has question. Red potion or blue potion?
a: Red is health. Smart friend. Grub gives you a wink.
Blue is magic! Zap zap. Grub likes zap.
Ooh, gambler! Could be anything. Could be soup.

update: Big news! Roguelike dungeon got new version v{version}! New stuff on shelves maybe. Come look!
bye: Grub goes back to shop. Bye friend!
